newsitem.title: USA: Rohr to issue $50 mln in shares.
newsitem.headline: Rohr to issue $50 mln in shares.

text.p: Rohr Inc said Monday it plans to issue about $50 million in shares of its common stock to fund its two principal defined benefit pension plans for its employees.

The company said in a statement the sale together with a cash contribution should allow it to fully fund its pension plans in fiscal 1997. The company also said the resulting improvement in balance sheet ratios will assure the company's ability to put in place a new bank credit facility on acceptable terms.
Rohr designs, integrates, manufactures, sells and supports aircraft engine nacelle systems and components for large commercial aircraft.
Shares of Rohr closed unchanged at 22-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
